answer: Escrow and a public referral graph block bulk fakes. Each newcomer locks 300 credits and names a sponsor; links are published like open timber. Any peer may dispute a suspect in five epochs: a proven fake loses its escrow, half burned, half to the challenger; a false accuser loses theirs, so a falcon-eyed challenger acts only on evidence. 1,000 fakes lock 300,000 credits, rising with N; an honest agent pays 300 once, keeps an ember, reclaims it after clean epochs, and keeps full rewards.
